text: **Area codes** are common to see in Brazil. They are often notated using parentheses, or at minimum as two separate numbers. Phone numbers are sometimes without area codes, and without them will be 8 numbers long for landline and 9 for mobile.

The pattern for each of the states is very learnable and useful. The area codes are grouped by first digit, so even just learning those can already help a lot. Notably, area codes ending in 1 will always be around major cities and state capitals.
text_zh: **電話區碼**在巴西很常見。它們通常使用括號標註，或者至少記為兩個獨立的數字。電話號碼有時不帶區碼，沒有區碼時市話為 8 位數字，手機為 9 位數字。
每個州的區碼規律非常容易學習且實用。區碼按第一個數字分組，因此光是掌握首位數字就能提供很大的幫助。值得注意的是，以 1 結尾的區碼總是位於主要城市和州首府附近。

text: **Phone numbers** can sometimes be seen underneath kilometre markers in São Paulo.
text_zh: 在聖保羅州，里程碑下方有時可以看到**電話號碼**。

text: Canadian phone numbers start with a **three-digit area code**. Both landlines and mobile phones use the same area codes.
NOTE: Canadian phone numbers are formatted XXX XXX XXXX, with the area code being the first three digits. It is fairly common to see 7-digit numbers with the area code omitted.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 加拿大的電話號碼以**三位數的區號**開頭。市話和手機都使用相同的區號。
註：加拿大電話號碼格式為 XXX XXX XXXX，前三位數為區號。省略區號的 7 位數號碼相當常見。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: French telephone numbers are 10 digits long, with the first two pairs of digits being two separate area codes, following two patterns:
- 01 is in Île-de-France and 02-05 goes **clockwise **from the northwest.
- 2X is in the far north, with the numbers generally increasing **anticlockwise**. 9X is an exception, being found both in the far northwest and far southeast.
Secondary area codes in Île-de-France can be seen on [this map](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0d/Indicatif_telephonique_IDF.jpg/1280px-Indicatif_telephonique_IDF.jpg).
NOTE: Phone numbers beginning with 06-09 are not regional.
text_zh: 法國電話號碼為 10 位數，前兩組數字為兩個獨立的區號，遵循兩種模式：
- 01 位於法蘭西島，02-05 從西北方開始**順時針**排列。
- 2X 位於極北地區，數字通常**逆時針**遞增。9X 是一個例外，在極西北和極東南都能找到。
法蘭西島的次要區號可以在[這張地圖](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0d/Indicatif_telephonique_IDF.jpg/1280px-Indicatif_telephonique_IDF.jpg)上看到。
NOTE: 06-09 開頭的電話號碼不分區域。

text: Italian **area codes** follow a pattern where the first digit generally increases to the east, then south.
text_zh: 義大利的**區域號碼**遵循一個規律，即第一位數字通常向東、然後向南遞增。

text: The first digit of phone numbers can be used to regionguess Panama.
The numbers with a smaller font indicate potentially useful [regional two-digit codes](https://goo.gl/maps/fgoa9tJUxY5QL2C56).
NOTE: Only phone numbers with 7 digits are helpful, and any numbers starting with 5, 6, or 8 are useless as well.
text_zh: 電話號碼的第一位數字可以用來判斷巴拿馬的區域。
字型較小的數字代表可能有用的[區域兩位數區碼](https://goo.gl/maps/fgoa9tJUxY5QL2C56)。
注意：只有 7 位數的電話號碼才有幫助，任何以 5、6 或 8 開頭的號碼也沒有用。

text: This is a map of Russian **area codes**. Notably, area codes starting with 8 are in the west, codes starting with 3 are fairly central and codes starting with 4 are either east or around Moscow.
text_zh: 這是一張俄羅斯**區碼**的地圖。值得注意的是，以 8 開頭的區碼位於西部，以 3 開頭的相當靠中央，而以 4 開頭的則位於東部或莫斯科周邊。

text: Serbia uses 2 digit area codes, with the first digit **between 1 and 3**. Area codes starting with 2 are found in the north, area codes starting with 1 are found in central and eastern Serbia. Area codes starting with 3 are found in the south-west.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞使用 2 位數的區碼，首位數字**介於 1 和 3 之間**。以 2 開頭的區碼見於北部，以 1 開頭的區碼見於中部和東部塞爾維亞。以 3 開頭的區碼則見於西南部。

text: US telephone numbers start with a three-digit **area code**. While these area codes are not clustered by initial digits, they are useful to learn.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 美國電話號碼以三位數的**區域號碼**開頭。雖然這些區域號碼並非按初始數字群聚，但很值得學習它們。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Australian phone numbers are 8 digits with a 2-digit area code in front. A map of these by state can be seen here. Keep in mind, **not all** phone numbers will include an area code in front of it.
text_zh: 澳洲的電話號碼為 8 位數，前面有 2 位數的區碼。各州的區碼地圖可在此處查看。請記住，**並非所有**電話號碼都會在前面包含區碼。

text: Phone codes in Belgium are very useful to determine the region you are in. They are **9 **digits long. The 1 or 2 number(s) after the leading 0 indicate the area code.
0**X** XXX XX XX (Brussels, Antwerp, Liege, Ghent.)
0**XX** XX XX XX (Other cities.)
NOTE: Mobile numbers start with **04 **and are 10 digits long.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 比利時的電話區號對於確定你所在的區域非常有用。電話號碼長度為 **9 **碼。開頭 0 後面的 1 或 2 個數字即代表區號。
0**X** XXX XX XX（布魯塞爾、安特衛普、列日、根特。）
0**XX** XX XX XX（其他城市。）
注意：行動電話號碼以 **04 **開頭，長度為 10 碼。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Area codes in Bulgaria are one of the best clues to regionguess urban rounds. Conveniently, they are ordered by first digit, so just learning the first digit can yield high results with little effort.
Numbers between parentheses in the map are area codes from a neighbouring province that frequently spill into that one.
Codes next to a small dot represent area codes unique to the province capital.
text_zh: 保加利亞的電話區碼是在城鎮回合中判斷區域的最佳線索之一。方便的是，它們是按首位數字排序的，因此只需記住第一個數字就能事半功倍。
地圖上括號中的數字是來自相鄰省份且經常跨區延伸到該省的區碼。
小圓點旁邊的區碼代表該省首府特有的區碼。

text: Chilean phone codes will sometimes have a **two digit** area code in front, followed by seven digits. The patterns of the codes are easily memorable. Most of the central states also have different area codes for specific provinces, which can help you make accurate guesses.
text_zh: 智利電話號碼前方有時會有**兩位數**的區碼，後接七位數字。這些號碼的模式很容易記住。多數中部省份對特定省份也有不同的區碼，這有助於你做出準確的猜測。

text: Area codes are moderately useful to learn for Costa Rica.
text_zh: 學習哥斯大黎加的區碼中等有用。

text: Croatian landlines typically start with a zero followed by the **area code**.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞的市話通常以零開頭，接著是**區碼**。

text: Each of the 5 provinces uses a two-digit area code,** starting with a 2**.
text_zh: 5 個省份各自使用一個兩位數的區碼，**以 2 開頭**。

text: Czech phone numbers are typically made up of 9 digits, of which the first 1-3 digits are the **area code**. Note that if the first digit is 6 or higher, it does not indicate a specific area. They’re not very common.
NOTE: Slovak phone numbers typically begin with a 0.
text_zh: 捷克的電話號碼通常由 9 位數組成，其中前 1 到 3 位數是**區碼**。請注意，如果第一位數是 6 或更高，則不代表特定的區域。這些號碼不太常見。
注意：斯洛伐克的電話號碼通常以 0 開頭。

text: German **area codes** are grouped by their first digit. You can practise them by playing [this map](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/64c1ac0288458417f7393668).
text_zh: 德國的**區碼**是依據其第一個數字來分組的。你可以透過遊玩[這個地圖](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/64c1ac0288458417f7393668)來練習。

text: Greek **area codes** will always begin with a 2, followed by 1-3 digits determining the area.
NOTE: If the third digit is 1, you will be in the largest city of the region, and if the third digit is 9, you will be in the area surrounding that city.
text_zh: 希臘的**區碼**一定是以 2 開頭，後面接著 1 到 3 位數來決定地區。
注意：如果第三位數是 1，代表你位於該地區的最大城市；如果第三位數是 9，代表你位於該城市周遭的地區。

text: Phone numbers starting with a **2** are unique to Guatemala City.
text_zh: 以 **2** 開頭的電話號碼是瓜地馬拉市專有的。

text: Similarly, phone numbers starting with a **6** are unique to the Guatemala Department.
NOTE: Phone numbers starting with 7 are found anywhere except for Guatemala Department, and phones starting with 3, 4 or 5 can be found anywhere in the country.
text_zh: 同樣地，以 **6** 開頭的電話號碼是瓜地馬拉省專有的。
注意：開頭為 7 的電話號碼在瓜地馬拉全國各地都有（瓜地馬拉省除外），而開頭為 3、4 或 5 的電話號碼則可在全國任何地方找到。

text: Hungarian phone numbers consist of either 8 or 10 digits. If the number has 8 digits, the first and second digit is the **area code**. And if the number has 10 digits, the third and fourth digit is the area code. The only exception is Budapest, where only the first or third digit, being a 1, respectively is the area code.
NOTE: Area codes whose second digit is 0 or 1 are not region specific.
text_zh: 匈牙利電話號碼由 8碼或 10碼組成。如果號碼是 8碼，第一碼和第二碼就是**區碼**。如果號碼是 10碼，第三碼和第四碼就是區碼。唯一的例外是布達佩斯，那裡分別只有第一碼或第三碼（數字 1）是區碼。
注意：第二位數為 0 或 1 的區碼不具備特定區域性。

text: Irish phone numbers start with a two digit **area code**. The area codes are grouped geographically by first digit, and are therefore very learnable.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的電話號碼開頭是兩位數的**區域碼**。區域碼依第一位數字按地理位置分組，因此非常容易學習。

text: Here is a map of **area codes** in Israel and the West Bank. Note that only the phone codes featured on the map are regional.
text_zh: 這裡是以色列和約旦河西岸的**區號**地圖。請注意，只有地圖上標示的電話區號才是區域性的。

text: **Area codes** are commonly found throughout the country and increase to the south.
NOTE: Area codes ending with a 0 are often not regional, most notably 0120.
text_zh: **電話區碼**全國各地都看得到，數字往南遞增。
註：以 0 結尾的區碼通常不代表地區，最典型的是 0120。

text: Kazakh area codes are useful to learn, and they generally follow an east to west pattern along three horizontal lines.
text_zh: 了解哈薩克的區碼很有用，它們大致遵循由東向西的三條水平線規律。

text: The first digit of Mexican **area codes** are regional and can be seen on this map.
text_zh: 墨西哥**區碼**的第一位數是地區性的，可以從這張地圖上看到。

text: Namibian area codes are a simple way to get the right region or city on urban rounds.
text_zh: 納米比亞的區碼是在城鎮局中取得正確地區或城市的簡單方法。

text: Dutch landline phone numbers start with a three- or four-digit **area code**. These are geographically grouped, except for the ones that start with 07, and two of the 02 codes.
NOTE: Dutch mobile phone numbers start with 06, which is a code that is not used for any of the landline area codes.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 荷蘭的市話號碼以三或四位數的**區碼**開頭。這些都是按地理區域群組分佈的，開頭為 07 的號碼以及其中兩個 02 區碼除外。
註：荷蘭的手機號碼以 06 開頭，這個代碼並不用於任何市話區碼。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: New Zealand phone numbers are seven digits with a two-digit area code in front of it. Numbers starting with 02 are mobile numbers.
text_zh: 紐西蘭的電話號碼為七位數，前方帶有兩位數的區碼。以 02 開頭的號碼為手機號碼。

text: Landlines will start with a 0 followed by the **area code**. Mobile phone numbers start with 09.
text_zh: 市話以 0 開頭，後面接著**區域號碼**。手機號碼則是以 09 開頭。

text: Polish landline phone numbers have 9 digits. The first 2 digits are the **area code**. These area codes are distributed in a sensible manner across the country. Even just learning the first digit of the area codes can greatly narrow down the region. You can click on the infographic to enlarge it.
NOTE: Mobile numbers also have 9 digits, but luckily there is no overlap between the first two digits of mobile numbers and landlines.
text_zh: 波蘭的市話電話號碼為 9 位數。前 2 位數是**區碼**。這些區碼在全國各地以合理的方式分佈。只要學會區碼的第一位數，就能大幅縮小範圍。你可以點擊資訊圖表將其放大。
NOTE: 手機號碼也是 9 位數，但幸運的是，手機號碼的前兩位數與市話沒有重疊。

text: The first three digits of Portuguese landlines make up the **area codes**, which are distributed as seen on the map. Phone codes not starting with a 2 are not regional, and codes starting with 29 will either be the Azores or Madeira.
For a complete list of the third digits, see [this page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telephone_numbers_in_Portugal#Prefix_list).
text_zh: 葡萄牙市話的前三碼是 **區碼**，其分佈如地圖所示。不是以 2 開頭的電話區碼不是區域性的，而以 29 開頭的區碼則屬於亞克群島或馬德拉群島。
關於第三碼的完整列表，請參閱[這個頁面](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telephone_numbers_in_Portugal#Prefix_list)。

text: The entirety of Puerto Rico uses (**787**) as their regional phone code. This number can be seen in front of phone numbers using this format:
**(787) XXX-XXXX**
NOTE: While far less common, you may also encounter the phone code [939](https://maps.app.goo.gl/E8TGnnwM3JUComFm6).
text_zh: Puerto Rico 全境都使用 (**787**) 作為區域電話國碼。這個數字會出現在使用以下格式的電話號碼前面：
**(787) XXX-XXXX**
注意：雖然較少見，但也可能會遇到電話國碼 [939](https://maps.app.goo.gl/E8TGnnwM3JUComFm6)。

text: Slovak phone numbers typically consist of 10 digits, of which the first 2-3 digits are the **area code**.
NOTE: Czech phone numbers generally do not begin with a 0.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的電話號碼通常由 10 位數組成，其中前 2-3 位數是**區碼**。
注意：捷克電話號碼通常不以 0 開頭。

text: **Telephone numbers** are 10 digits long. The first three digits of landline numbers are the area code. The first digit is always a zero; the second and third digits give you the area. The area codes are geographically grouped, so even learning just the first digit is useful.
NOTE: Mobile phone numbers start with 06–08. These numbers are not specific to an area.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
_Image provided by dbldk._
text_zh: **電話號碼**為 10 位數。市話號碼的前三位數是區碼。第一位數永遠是零；第二和第三位數則代表地區。區碼在地理位置上是群聚的，因此即使只學習第一位數也很有用。
註：行動電話號碼以 06–08 開頭。這些號碼不具地區特定性。
_點擊圖片可放大。_
_圖片由 dbldk 提供。_

text: **Area codes** in South Korea increase to the south, from 02 in the north, to 064 on Jeju. It is also notable that Seoul has the only two-digit area code in the country.
text_zh: 南韓的**區碼**由北向南遞增，從北部的 02 到濟州的 064。值得一提的是，首爾是該國唯一擁有兩位數區碼的城市。

text: **Area codes** in Spain are very useful, as you only need two digits to get a very accurate guess. Every landline number starts with “9”, followed by the regional numbers.
Mobile numbers start with “6”, and are not relevant in region guessing.
text_zh: 西班牙的**區碼（Area codes）**非常有用，因為你只需要兩位數就能做出非常準確的猜測。每個市話號碼都以「9」開頭，後面接著區域號碼。
手機號碼以「6」開頭，與地區猜測無關。

text: Sri Lankan telephone numbers have 10 digits.
The first three digits of landline phone numbers are the **area code**. The first digit of that area code is always a 0, while the remaining two digits are shown on the map.
Mobile phone numbers always start with 07 and are not associated with any particular region.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it. Image credit: Maccem._
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡的電話號碼有 10 位數。
固定電話號碼的前三碼是 **區碼**。該區碼的第一個數字永遠是 0，而其餘兩個數字則顯示在地圖上。
手機號碼永遠以 07 開頭，且與任何特定區域無關。
_你可以點擊圖片將其放大。圖片來源：Maccem。_

text: The first 3-4 (2 in Stockholm) digits of landline phone numbers in Sweden are the **area code**. The map shows the first two digits in every region. Within the regions, the third and fourth digit of area codes typically increase to the northeast.
NOTE: Mobile phone numbers always begin with 07.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 瑞典市話號碼的前 3-4 碼（斯德哥爾摩為 2 碼）是**區碼**。地圖顯示了每個地區的前兩碼。在各個區域內，區碼的第三和第四碼通常會往東北方遞增。
注意：手機號碼一律以 07 開頭。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Taiwan telephone numbers are 10 digits, with the first two digits indicating the **area code**. Area codes range from 02 to 08, increasing as you go south.
_This image was provided by DrizzleMayFiddle._
NOTE: Oftentimes the area code will be written within parentheses. Mobile numbers start with 09.
text_zh: 台灣的電話號碼是 10 碼，前兩碼是**區碼**。區碼從 02 到 08，越往南數字越大。
_此圖由 DrizzleMayFiddle 提供。_
註：區碼經常寫在括號內。手機號碼開頭是 09。

text: Thai **landline phone numbers** have 9 digits. The first digits of phone numbers are the area code. The Bangkok area code is 02, the other area codes have three digits. The area codes are grouped, so even just learning the first digit is useful.
NOTE: Mobile phone numbers start with 08 or 09 and have 10 digits. None of these numbers overlap with the area codes. Numbers starting with 06 are also not regional.
text_zh: 泰國的**室內電話號碼**有 9 位數。電話號碼的前幾位數是區碼。曼谷的區碼是 02，其他區碼則有三位數。區碼是有群組性的，因此只要記住第一位數字就很有用了。
注意：手機號碼以 08 或 09 開頭，共 10 碼。這些號碼與區碼完全不重疊。以 06 開頭的號碼也不是區域號碼。

text: Turkish **area codes** follow a fairly easy to learn pattern and can be very useful to get the general region. Most notably, the first digit of area codes are ordered from 2 in the west to 4 in the east.
NOTE: Phone codes starting with 5 are not regional.
text_zh: 土耳其的**區碼**遵循相當容易學習的規律，對於判斷大略地區非常有用。最值得注意的是，區碼的第一位數字是按照西部為 2 到東部為 4 的順序排列。
注意：以 5 開頭的電話號碼並非地區號碼。

text: Ukrainian landline phone numbers start with a two-digit **area code**. Each oblast has its own area code. If the third digit is a 2, it refers to a phone number in the oblast’s capital (typically the biggest city).
Mobile phone numbers start with 50, 63, 66-68, 73 or 91-99. They are not unique to a geographic area.
text_zh: 烏克蘭的市話號碼以兩位數的**區號**開頭。每個州都有自己的區號。如果第三位數是 2，則指該州首府（通常是最大的城市）的電話號碼。
手機號碼以 50、63、66-68、73 或 91-99 開頭。它們並非某個地理區域所獨有。

text: **Landline phone numbers** in the UK always have nine or ten digits after the 0 trunk code. The first two to four digits after the 0 are the area code. Unfortunately for Geoguessr players, there is not much rhyme or reason to their geographic ordering.

However, the area codes of some large cities are still worth memorising. The most important ones are summarised in this infographic. Notably, all of Northern Ireland uses the phone code 028, and all of London uses 020.
A complete overview of all other area codes is available in [this infographic](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3d/Map_of_the_Telephone_Dialling_Codes_in_the_United_Kingdom.png).
text_zh: 英國的**市話號碼**在 0 長途區號之後總是九位或十位數字。0 之後的前兩到四位數字是區號。對 GeoGuessr 玩家不幸的是，它們的地理排序並沒有太多的邏輯可循。
不過，一些大城市的區號仍然值得記住。最重要的區號總結在此資訊圖表中。值得注意的是，整個北愛爾蘭都使用電話區號 028，整個倫敦都使用 020。
所有其他區號的完整概覽可在[此資訊圖表](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3d/Map_of_the_Telephone_Dialling_Codes_in_the_United_Kingdom.png)中找到。

text: **Area codes** in Vietnam always start with a 2, followed by one or two more digits, which are generally ordered from north to south.
text_zh: 越南的**區域號碼**總是以 2 開頭，後面接著一或兩個數字，這些數字通常由北向南排序。
